requirements.description: The user can inspect step-level execution strategy and attributable cost.
requirements.evidence_expectation: An operator read of persisted step, method, and cost records.

checks.note: The workbench reads stored revisions and evaluation cases. The outcome-verification child does not receive a database URL, so this check is not executable there. Builder evidence is the disposable pytest and the Chrome walk.

requirements.description: At least one candidate changes model selection based on task requirements.
requirements.evidence_expectation: A candidate revision whose routed method differs from baseline on the same observed category.

checks.note: Stored economy and premium revisions route observed categories differently. Not run inside outcome verification because the database URL is not passed to the child.

requirements.description: At least one candidate uses deterministic execution instead of an unnecessary LLM call.
requirements.evidence_expectation: A persisted deterministic attempt. The demo acceptance candidate uses economy, not deterministic. Deterministic replacement is covered by the deterministic method tests and is a quality regression on the acceptance cohort.

checks.note: tests/test_deterministic_method.py does not need a database. It is not approved here because a method unit test is not the operator outcome. The paired deterministic candidate is in the disposable evaluation test.

requirements.description: Baseline and candidate are compared on equivalent, versioned evaluation cases.
requirements.evidence_expectation: Paired case rows bound to one cohort manifest.

checks.note: Disposable pytest covers the paired cohort. The verifier child has no database URL.

requirements.description: Cost per verified successful outcome is computed from execution and evaluation records.
requirements.evidence_expectation: The quotient is recomputed from persisted costs and verified-success counts.

checks.note: The pure gate tests cover the rational comparison. They are not approved as this user outcome because they do not read the database.

requirements.description: Individual quality failures and policy violations are inspectable.
requirements.evidence_expectation: A case read model shows verdict, reason, and critical-violation flag, without a reference category.

checks.note: GET evaluation cases returns verdicts and observed category. reference_category is absent. Needs the disposable database.

requirements.description: A failing or inconclusive candidate cannot be activated as approved.
requirements.evidence_expectation: Activation of a blocked, ineligible, v0, forged, or production-scoped request leaves the pointer unchanged.

checks.note: Covered by test_synthetic_demo_can_activate_verify_and_restore_without_production_authority on a disposable database. The verifier does not receive that URL.

requirements.description: Eligible policy activation and restoration work in the demo and leave an audit trail.
requirements.evidence_expectation: Compare-and-swap activation, a verification record, and an explicit restore.

checks.note: The same disposable test activates, verifies the disjoint cohort, and restores the compared baseline. It is not an outcome-verification PASS.

requirements.description: The basic demonstration runs without enterprise credentials or services.
requirements.evidence_expectation: Local synthetic execution and a disposable Postgres. No live provider.

checks.note: The demonstration uses a local Postgres container and synthetic prices. Railway was not used for this slice.

requirements.description: Simulated, replayed, estimated, and live-measured evidence are explicitly distinguished.
requirements.evidence_expectation: Attempt origin, label origin, and modeled origin stay distinct. Replay is not provider-measured.

checks.note: Persisted attempts use synthetic_simulated. Modeled allocations use synthetic_modeled and are excluded from the quotient. Live-provider attempts block activation.

requirements.description: Pure synthetic-demo and v0 judgment tests. These do not accept UO-001.
Four workbench destinations bound to persisted records.
requirements.evidence_expectation: A browser walk of Operate, Investigate, Strategies, and Releases against the API.

plan.blocked_reason: The journey needs a running API, a running Next server, and system Chrome. The outcome-verification child does not start those processes.

requirements.description: Integrated acceptance beyond the mapped checks.
requirements.evidence_expectation: Hypothesis, Schemathesis, accessibility, visual regression, and mutation runs are not installed.

plan.blocked_reason: Those tools were not added. Their absence is not a PASS.
